transcripts.title: School transcripts (grades 10–11)
transcripts.detail: Official transcripts of the last school years, usually with English translation.

current_grades.title: Current / predicted grades
current_grades.detail: Mid-year grades or a predicted-grades letter from the school.

diploma.title: Secondary school diploma (after graduation)
diploma.detail: Usually submitted after graduation, before enrolment.

ua_certificate_recognition.title: Ukrainian school certificate accepted for entry
ua_certificate_recognition.detail: Check whether the Ukrainian certificate of complete general secondary education is accepted directly, or needs NMT results, an extra year of study or a foundation year.

english.title: English proficiency proof
english.detail: Usually IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT or Cambridge. Check minimum scores and exemptions.

translations.title: Translations of school documents
translations.detail: Certified translations into English (and sometimes apostille/legalisation).
